Introduction 引言
When Dario Amodei left OpenAI to start Anthropic in early 2021, the viral release of ChatGPT was over 18 months away and the commercialization of LLMs was practically zero. Just a few short years later, Anthropic and OpenAI combine for \~\$100B of ARR and a clear winner emerged in the profitable monetization of AI models in 2026 as Claude Code took the software development world by storm.
当达里奥·阿莫代于 2021年初离开OpenAI创立Anthropic 时，ChatGPT的病毒式传播还要等18个月以上，LLMs 的商业化几乎为零。短短几年后，Anthropic 和OpenAI合计年经常性收入突破1000 亿美元，而在 2026年，随着 ClaudeCode席卷软件开发领域，AI模型盈利化中一个明确的获胜者已经出现。
Anthropic confidentially filed for IPO on June 1st. Over 1 month later, equity raises from hyperscalers loom, and a reported OpenAI push out of their own IPO until 2027 has led some to question the ability of the labs to raise. Anthropic于6月1日秘密提交了IPO 申请。一个多月后，来自超大规模云服务商的股权融资迫在眉睫，同时有报道称OpenAI将其IPO 推迟至 2027年，这引发了一些人对AI实验室融资能力的质疑。然而，在今天，Anthropic 在捕捉 B2B 市场方面显然是绝对的领跑者，并且以一种盈利的方式，对抗着一个缺乏专注且烧钱的竞争对手。
With this lead, we expect Anthropic to take advantage of their superior business model and margins to invest in further in new models that help extend their lead and monetization over closed and open source competitors. Anthropic has the ability to truly make OpenAI dance and we see Anthropic as the first \$6T company as a basecase possibility if they continue to execute. Pricing power, gross margins, business model, and profitability are allreasons for Anthropic to IPO first and put the impetus on OpenAI to open their financials and raise the necessary capital to compete and fund the massive AI buildout still to come.
凭借这一优势，我们预计 Anthropic 将利用其卓越的商业模式和利润率，进一步投资开发新模型，从而扩大其对闭源和开源竞争对手的领先优势及变现能力。Anthropic完全有能力让OpenAI疲于应对，我们认为若Anthropic 持续高效执行战略，其成为首家市值达6万亿美元的公司是基本可能。定价权、毛利率、商业模式及盈利能力等综合因素，都将促使 Anthropic 率先启动IPO，迫使OpenAI不得不公开财务数据并筹集必要资金以应对竞争，为即将到来的大规模AI基础设施建设提供资金支持。

Background of the IPO IPO 背景
Anthropic's capital position is strong. With over \$100B raised,a profitable business model (on a non-GAAP basis), and strong gross margins, why go public in the age of seemingly endless VC dollars and companies like Stripe and Databricks choosing to stay out of the public eye? We see three major reasons:
Anthropic的资本状况十分稳健。在募集超过1000亿美元、实现盈利（按非公认会计准则计算）且保持高毛利率的情况下，为何要在风投资金看似取之不尽、且Stripe 和Databricks等公司选择远离公众视野的时代上市？我们认为主要有三个原因:
Access to equity and debt markets (which will become a necessity)
获取股权和债务市场融资 (这将成为必要之举)
Audited and public financials help ease enterprises making large contract commitments
经审计的公开财报有助于缓解企业在签订大额合同时的顾虑
Make the talent war easier by allowing employees to easily sell shares
通过允许员工轻松出售股份，简化人才争夺战
In the current world of talent deals that rival professional sports and massive and growing compute needs, having liquid public equity and the ability to raise debt and 在当下人才争夺激烈堪比职业体育、且算力需求巨大且持续增长的世界里，拥有可流 通的公开股权以及快速筹集债务和股本的能力，具有战略意义。

Like the above market rate SpaceX deal, we expect Anthropic to purchase additional compute from trusted vendors such as Meta, who was recently rumored as of 7/1/26 to explore the business of renting compute to external parties. Our Tokenomics Model shows the stark difference between unconstrained demand for compute from Anthropic (based on Training spend as a % of revenue and Inference ARR per MW) and the supply-based method in our Datacenter Model which tracks the timeline and progress of data center builds. 我们认为，这些资金将用于填补Anthropic 在推理运算、新模型训练投资与可获取算力之间日益扩大的供需缺口。与上述 SpaceX 市场利率交易类似，Anthropic预计将从 Meta等可信供应商处采购额外算力——近期有传言称，Meta自2026年7月1日起正探索向外部方出租算力的业务。我们的通证经济学模型清晰展示了Anthropic 算力需求（基于训练支出占收入比及推理ARR/MW指标）与数据中心模型追踪的建设进度所反映的供应能力之间的悬殊差距。

In fact, we see over 100GW of compute demand between OpenAI and Anrthropic by the end of 2030. This willrequire over 90GW of net compute additions through 2030 vs 2.5GW added in 2025 and 5GW in 2026. Today, we estimate OpenAI and Anthropic have access to just over 6GW of compute.
实际上，我们预测到 2030 年底，OpenAI与 Anthropic 的算力需求合计将超过100GW。这意味着到2030年需净新增超90GW算力，而2025年新增量仅为2.5GW，2026 年预计达5GW。当前我们估算OpenAI与 Anthropic 可获取的算力仅略超6GW。
During 1Q26, Anthropic users felt this compute shortage. Rate limits,downtime, and other throtling measures made using Claude difficult. As we've Written in the_past for our Tokenomics subscribers, Anthropic's gross margins in their API business are extremely strong. Access to open capital markets wil help Anthropic exploit its superior margins and secure capital at favorable rates to bid up compute to levels rivals will struggle to match. As we explain in detail in the Business Overview section, OpenAI currently doesn't have the same luxury.
在 2026 年第一季度，Anthropic 用户切实感受到了计算资源短缺。频率限制、服务宕机及其他限流措施让Claude的使用变得困难重重。正如我们此前在Tokenomics 订阅内容中所述，Anthropic 的API业务毛利率极为强劲。开放资本市场将有助于Anthropic发挥其利润率优势，以优惠利率获取资金，从而将计算资源竞价推升至竞争对手难以匹敌的水平。正如我们在业务概览章节中详细阐述的，OpenAI目前尚未享有同等优势。

In June,Alphabet raised \$84.75B of equity. Meta has been rumored to raise in the tens of billions range.As we discussed in our FCF to Zero note to institutional subscribers back in April, hyperscalers will not generate sufficient operating cash flow to pay for their capex needs in 2027 and beyond. This funding, along with the rest of the AI buildout, must come from somewhere. Regardless of how cheap it is, capital is always 今年6月，Alphabet完成了847.5亿美元的股权融资。据传Meta的融资规模也高达 数百亿美元。正如我们在4月份向机构订阅用户发布的《自由现金流归零》报告中所 述，超大规模云服务商在2027年及以后将无法产生足够的经营现金流来支撑资本开支 需求。这些资金连同人工智能基础设施建设的其余投入，必须另寻来源。无论资本成 本多低，资本始终面临竞争，而供给量正急剧且快速地增长。

The market to raise equity has quickly shifted, and financing will only become more necessary. Google had not issued equity since 2006. Microsoft has been buying back stock to the tune of \$20B/yr for the past 7 years. These are the world's best businesses, and they are telling you the ROIC and demand for serving someone else's AI models and infrastructure is so high that it is worth taking combined hyperscaler FCF into the negative 9 figures in CY2027. We forecast Anthropic and OpenAI's compute needs as ever growing, and they will become an increasing percentage of total hyperscaler and neo-cloud (including SpaceX and Meta) compute as the buildout continues.
股权市场风向已迅速转变，融资需求只会愈发迫切。谷歌自2006年以来从未发行过股票，而微软在过去七年里每年斥资 200 亿美元进行股票回购。这些全球顶尖的企业正用行动表明：为他人提供AI模型与基础设施服务的投资回报率（ROIC）及需求如此之高，以至于到 2027年，超大规模云服务商的自由现金流（FCF）可能会合计跌至负九位数。我们预测，随着基础设施建设的持续推进，Anthropic与OpenAI的算力需求将持续增长，其在超大规模云服务商及新型云平台（包括SpaceX和Meta）总算力中的占比将不断攀升。
There is no better time than now to raise.Meta will soon raise equity and others have already tapped the markets. As such, the timeline and urgency for Anthropic to raise is clear: capital, and access to it, will be needed.
当前正是融资的最佳时机。Meta 即将启动股权融资，其他企业也已先行试水。因此,Anthropic的融资时间表与紧迫性已然明确：资本，以及获取资本的渠道，将成为其核心需求。

Claude Code is now over 7% of total GitHub Commits and has powered the sharp ARR acceleration that Anthropic saw to start 2026. Anthropic ended 2025 with \$9B of ARR; today, that number is over \$60B. This mix of success in the coding vertical paired with its usage-based pricing model dominates Anthropic ARR today. ClaudeCode目前已占GitHub 总提交量的7%以上，并推动了Anthropic 在 2026 年初ARR 的急剧加速增长。Anthropic 在 2025 年底的ARR为90 亿美元；如今，这一数字已超过600亿美元。这种在编码垂直领域的成功，结合其基于使用量的定价模式，目前主导了Anthropic的ARR。该公司拥有多个不同的产品线和层级，但基于使用量的定价业务（我们称之为API）占其收入的75%至85%。相比之下，OpenAI历来以消费者和订阅模式为重点一一但情况正在发生变化。

Anthropic's revenue composes several product areas across both subscription and API usage-based pricing. For subscriptions,the company has several business lines: Consumer, Team,and Enterprise.
Anthropic 的收入由订阅和基于API使用量定价的多个产品领域组成。在订阅方面,该公司拥有多条业务线：个人版、团队版和企业版。
Consumer is split into Free, Pro, Max 5x,and Max 20x with pricing on the paid plans \$20, \$100,and \$200/month respectively when billed monthly. Claude Code, Cowork, and features like Claude for Microsoft 365 are included on all paid plans. Our analysis of card panel data suggests that the average paying US consumer is spending around \$45/month on Claude. Team subscriptions are for SMBs between 5-150 seats and are \$20 or \$100/month when billed annually.
消费端分为免费版、Pro版、Max 5x版和Max 20x版，付费套餐按月订阅的价格分别为每月20美元、100美元和200 美元。所有付费套餐均包含ClaudeCode、Cowork以及Claude forMicrosoft365 等功能。我们对银行卡面板数据的分析显示，美国付费用户平均每月在Claude上的支出约为45美元。团队订阅面向5至150个席位的中小企业，按年付费时价格为每月20美元或100美元。
Both consumer and team subscriptions have an opaque usage-based system for burning tokens. SemiAnalysis work on the equivalent API token spend showed that subscriptions provide much more usage than the cost for the equivalent task load on API, but Anthropic has the ultimate say on when and how much usage may be throttled.
消费端和团队订阅均采用不透明的基于使用量的令牌消耗机制。半分析团队对等效API令牌支出的研究显示，相比API上的同等任务量成本，订阅提供了更多使用额度，但Anthropic 对何时以及何种程度的使用可能被限速拥有最终决定权。
For enterprise subscriptions,however, no usage is included for the subscription price.After 150 seats on the Team plan, you are required to pay \$20/month plus the API ratesfor allusage. This API business is where the vast majority of ARR falls today. Subscriptions make up just 15% of total ARR. Compare this to OpenAI and you'll see a stark contrast. During 1Q26, OpenAI was over 65% subscription based. The business Vs consumer split is even more stark. Just 5% of Anthropic ARR today comes from Consumer subscriptions vs our estimates of OpenAI around 40% at the end of 2Q26 (the CCO of OpenAI said in a blog that B2B was around 40% of total ARR in 1Q26). Claude Code's success has levered Anthropic to the right tailwinds and business model. As we show 如今，Anthropic绝大部分年度经常性收入（ARR）均来自API业务，订阅收入仅占 总ARR的15%。与OpenAI对比可见显著差异——2026年第一季度，OpenAI超 65%收入源于订阅。企业端与消费端的分化更为悬殊：当前Anthropic 消费端订阅仅 占 ARR 的5%，而据我们估算，截至 2026 年第二季度末，OpenAI该比例约为 40% （OpenAI首席商务官在博客中透露，2026年第一季度 B2B业务约占总ARR 的 40%)。ClaudeCode的成功使Anthropic 顺应市场风向并优化商业模式，如后文利润 率章节所示，API业务的利润率远优于订阅业务。

By focusing on API revenue, there is no ceiling on how much revenue can be generated from a single user because it's billed by token rather than by seat. As the same user/customer adopts more agentic workflows, they consume more tokens and generate more revenue without Anthropic needing to add another customer. The disclosures show this. Anthropic CFO Krishna Rao shared on the Invest Like the Best podcast in early May that Net Dollar Retention, the measure of how much spend has increased at customers who were with the company at least 1 year prior, was 500%. This means \$12B of Anthropic's \$30B of 1Q26 ARR was driven by the customers who were just \$2B of ARR in 1Q25. This means there is still \$18B of new customer ARR added over the last year who are stil ramping their spend and powering Anthropic's growth higher.
通过聚焦API收入，单个用户能带来的收入没有上限，因为计费方式是按 token 而非按席位。当同一用户/客户采用更多智能体工作流时，他们会消耗更多token并产生更多收入，而Anthropic 无需新增客户。披露信息证实了这一点。Anthropic 首席财务官克里希纳·拉奥在5月初的《InvestLike the Best》播客中透露，净美元留存率（衡量与公司合作至少一年的客户支出增长指标）达到 500%。这意味着 Anthropic 2026年第一季度 300亿美元ARR中，有120亿美元来自 2025年第一季度仅贡献 20亿美元ARR 的客户群体。而过去一年新增的180 亿美元ARR客户仍在持续增加支出，推动Anthropic 实现更高增长。
OpenAI is improving, however. The SemiAnalysis Tokenomics team believes that API has been responsible for driving the reacceleration in OpenAI ARR since the March release of 5.5 and Codex and B2B API are now the majority of monthly NNARR. This revenue is higher in margin and could help OpenAI reach profitability sooner than expected.
不过OpenAI也在进步。SemiAnalysis 代币经济学团队认为，自3月发布5.5和Codex 以来，API已成为OpenAIARR 重新加速的核心驱动力，B2BAPI目前占月度新增ARR的大部分。这类收入利润率更高，可能帮助OpenAI比预期更早实现盈利。
The AI Lab inference business model is simple. Revenue is dictated by token volume and blended token prices. Token volume has skyrocketed, but blended token pricing has declined over time. With higher token pricing on new models, how has blended pricing gone down? Cache rates, input/output ratios,and agentic vs chat workflow mix are all factors in determining blended token pricing. The Tokenomics Model tracks

and projects pricing on a per product (Consumer Max, Free, API, etc.) and per model basis. As more agentic work gets adopted, revenue growth is driven by rising token consumption. Agentic workflows consume significantly more tokens than the traditional chat function, and blended token prices have actually fallen drastically since 2024. The consumption curve, then, is doing all the work in driving revenue growth.

然而，这一切的前提是有足够的算力来支撑需求。我们预测，到 2030年，各大实验室对算力的无约束需求将超过100GW。资本必须满足这一需求，而这正是此次IPO 更宏大的叙事：今年，一些有史以来最优秀的企业（超大规模云服务商）将发行超过1000 亿美元的股票，这仅仅是未来2-3年内为满足需求而持续大规模建设所需资本的序曲。Anthropic 和OpenAI的 IPO 是整个生态系统的转折点，该生态系统每年需要数万亿美元的融资渠道。
Conclusion & Valuation 结论与估值
Anthropic has built an enviable business. The company is the clear winner in the AI Lab race across the two most important financial metrics: growth rate and

profitability. However, OpenAI is catching up in the areas that matter. Codex reception and our enterprise spending checks on API have been overwhelmingly positive since the release of 5.5. OpenAI's ability to continue to accelerate NNARR via their API business willbe the deciding factor in how big a lead Anthropic can take.
Anthropic打造了一家令人羨慕的企业。在增长率和盈利能力这两个最重要的财务指标上，该公司是AI实验室竞赛中的明显赢家。然而，OpenAI正在关键领域迎头赶上。自5.5版本发布以来，Codex 的反馈以及我们对API企业支出的调研结果都极为积极。OpenAI通过其API业务持续加速 NNARR的能力，将决定Anthropic 能够保持多大的领先优势。
Thus,we believe Anthropic should attempt to IPO first. Their financials are better, their business model is better,and they can continue to press that advantage and force capital their way. The impetus is then on OpenAI to raise equity with worse financials and dollar growth, so Anthropic should keep their foot on the gas.
因此，我们认为Anthropic 应当率先尝试IPO。其财务状况更优，商业模式更佳，且能持续扩大这一优势并吸引资本。这样一来，OpenAI便面临以更差的财务表现和增长数据来筹集股权的压力，因此Anthropic应保持全力推进的态势。
Our base case for valuation is 20x 2027,ending ARR of \$300B (\~15B/month of NNARR in 2027). This would put Anthropic's enterprise value at \$6 trillion - making it the world's largest company.
